slides.title: What are you like before you trust the room?

body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.
Three games tonight: standing, guarded, pinned. Win one and the next round gets harder. Lose it and you run the same one again.
Hand Touch / Knee Touch Collection Game
Skill Learning Objective (SLO): Entering, for both players.
Both players stand facing each other, hand fighting range, no grips to start.
Hand fight and collect three touches, any mix. A touch is making your partner's hands touch the mat, or gripping behind one of his knees. Defend his touches at the same time.

items: Whoever gets three touches first wins the round. The same rule applies to both players.

body.text: SLO: Arriving for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is belly up, feet in the middle, one hand on the top player's ankle. The top player is standing.

Bottom player: keep your feet hooked or posted on the top player at all times, and a hand on him too. Use that to put him on his hips or hands. Top player: break those connections with your hands and feet, and work to the outside for shin-to-body contact.

items: The bottom player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps his connections.
The top player wins by breaking every connection and making shin-to-body contact from outside the legs.

body.text: SLO: Controlling for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is on his back. The top player is chest to chest on top of him.
Top player: hold chest to chest and keep the bottom player there. Bottom player: push the top player off and get your legs back in front.

items: The top player has no time limit. He holds the pin.
The bottom player wins by pushing the top player off and getting his legs back in front.

options.feedback: That is the win condition, and nothing else scores.

Never. Everyone goes light, and the tap always stops it right away, every time.
